reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getRangedScheduleAmount helper and routes the one remaining inline midpoint copy (schedule-template.ts) through it.

duplication.why: No new logic is duplicated; the change removes the last hand-written midpoint computation.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where the tree already defined it.

scope.why: One-line rule change, one call-site replacement, comment updates, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: All ranged-amount consumers now go through one small, documented function, so a future rule change is again one edit.

one_place.where: getRangedScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount, forecast-schedules, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule) and now schedule-template.ts.
